## Topics
- Importing and cleaning a messy line list (readr, janitor)
- Parsing dates with lubridate: ymd(), mdy(), dmy()
- Date parts and date arithmetic: year(), month(), days between events
- Weekly and monthly counts with floor_date()
- Epidemic curves
- Missing data: finding it and deciding what to do
- Recoding with case_when() and forcats
- Ethics: privacy and de-identification of health data

## Learning objectives
By the end of this module you should be able to:

- Parse text into real dates and pull out date parts
- Compute intervals in days (e.g., onset to hospitalization)
- Count cases by week or month and draw an epidemic curve
- Describe how much data is missing and handle it deliberately
- Explain why de-identified data can still put people at risk

## Data
H7N9 avian influenza, China 2013 (`outbreaks::fluH7N9_china_2013`); assignment: MERS, South Korea 2015 (`outbreaks::mers_korea_2015`)
